## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A second one-fascicle parallel rendering of the **Jāṅgulī** material treated above in [KR6j0494](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0494) (T1264a), also by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)). Zhōnghuá H1421. CANWWW preserves this under T21N1264B alongside T21N1264A.

**Abstract**

The same Jāṅgulīdhāraṇī material as T1264a, with variations in mantra-form, framing-narrative, and the *anuśaṃsā* catalogue. The two renderings were both retained because the divergences in the Indian source-recensions could not be reduced. Date: Amoghavajra's Chángān activity, 746–774.
